title: Delayed metadata enrichment and consistent header mapping for scheduled customer CSV exports
creator: Priya Patel
description:
Problem: Several customers have reported inconsistencies in scheduled CSV exports where metadata columns (region, billable_unit, model_variant) are either missing or appear with different header names between export runs. These inconsistencies break downstream ingestion pipelines and cause customer confusion. Root cause appears to be a race between the export generation job and the metadata enrichment workers; when enrichment is still in-flight the export generator samples a partial view and writes an ad-hoc header mapping. Additionally, our header mapping logic has evolved organically (legacy alias rules + incremental schema additions) and lacks a canonical schema migration path for exports.

Impact: Intermittent downstream failures for large customers with automated ingestion. Support noise and manual remediation required (CSV column remaps, backfills). Reproducible in staging by scheduling high-concurrency exports while simultaneous enrichment jobs run.

Goal: Ensure scheduled CSV exports always publish a deterministic, fully-populated header set and that metadata enrichment is either materialized before the export starts or the export is blocked/rescheduled until enrichment is complete. Provide clear schema versioning and migration so header names do not flip unexpectedly between releases.
technical_approach:
1) Add an export staging table (export_runs_staging) that atomically stores the set of row payloads and a metadata-complete flag.
2) Change export generator to create a draft export in staging and wait for metadata_complete=true before serializing CSV or emitting S3/webhook. Implement a bounded wait + controlled reschedule path for long-running enrichments.
3) Introduce an explicit export schema version field and a canonical header mapping registry (managed migration records). Exports include schema_version in the manifest.
4) Make header mapping idempotent: header names derived from registry + stable fallback rules (no ad-hoc normalization at export time).
5) Update webhook payloads and S3 manifesting to reference the export_run_id and schema_version so downstream syncs can validate.
6) Add metrics: enrichment_lag_seconds, exports_waiting_for_metadata, header_mismatch_count. Wire alerts (PagerDuty for enrichment_lag > 10m for high-priority tenants).
7) Backfill plan: run a backfill job that reprocesses failed/partial exports in the last 30 days into the new staging pipeline and re-emit manifests to S3 with schema_version tag.
acceptance_criteria:
1) No customer-reported header flips in two consecutive weeks for scheduled exports after rollout.
2) Metric exports_waiting_for_metadata exists and is < 1% of scheduled exports for steady state.
3) New exports always include schema_version in S3 manifests and webhook payloads.
4) Backfill completes for top-5 impacted tenants and verification scripts confirm header/column parity.
5) PR with tests and integration runbook merged and console feature flag ready for canary rollout.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Waiting for enrichment may increase export latency for some tenants. Mitigation: bounded wait (configurable, default 30s) + reschedule with exponential backoff and user-visible status in Console. Risk: Backfill may be expensive for large tenants. Mitigation: throttle backfill by tenant, use sampling + customer opt-in for full replays, provide estimated cost before running. Risk: Schema migration errors. Mitigation: add dry-run migration mode, automated header compatibility checks and a manual approval step for registry changes.
updates: 2026-02-20 - Initial triage: replicated header mismatch in staging with concurrent enrichment runs. Filed ENG-210045.

2026-02-26 - Spike complete: verified race between enrichment workers and export serializer; spike repo with prototype staging table at https://github.com/redwood-inference/exports-spike/pull/12. MVP design reviewed with Data Platform and Observability.
2026-03-02 - Design review: PMs (Liam O'Neill) requested explicit schema_version and manifest changes; updated design doc at https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ENG/Export+Schema+Registry.

2026-03-07 - Implementation: created export_runs_staging schema and initial consumer in sandbox cluster; unit tests added for header registry lookup. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4872.

2026-03-10 - Ops sync: agreed on alert thresholds for enrichment_lag_seconds; grafana panel draft at https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/exports/exports-health. Also noted dependency on ENF-206501 for enrichment worker autoscaling (added dependency).

2026-03-12 - QA: integration tests failing for incremental export path; root cause is incremental exporter reusing legacy alias map. Working on patch to read canonical registry instead of alias cache.
Next steps: finish registry migration tool, fix incremental exporter, run canary for 10% of scheduled exports, and schedule backfill window for impacted tenants.
